title: Multi-Year Term Credit Schedule, Domain Care on Grace-Period Renewal Charges (Domain Registrations)
content:
## Term credit schedule

A grace-period renewal charge of Domain Registrations billed from 1 January 2022 through 30 November 2025 and paid by card or PayPal earns, as one of the charge's Domain Care credits, the grace line's term credit, set by the years the charge covered:

| Years the charge covered | Grace line's term credit |
|---|---|
| 5 or more | USD 0.60 times the years the charge covered |
| 2 to 4 | the flat USD 1.00, whatever the years |
| 1 | nothing |

The years are those recorded on the charge line itself.

### Boundary cases

- A charge covering 1 year: nothing.
- A charge covering 2 years: USD 1.00.
- A charge covering 4 years: USD 1.00.
- A charge covering 5 years: USD 0.60 for each of 5 years, USD 3.00.
- A charge covering 8 years: USD 4.80.

Between 4 and 5 years the credit changes form, from a flat sum to a sum for each year: at 4 years it is USD 1.00, at 5 years USD 3.00.
